primary.title: Desktop app: command-chip renderer matches the command-name tag anywhere in message content, faking a /clear and hiding scrollback (no actual clear)
primary.note: OPEN, labels bug / platform:macos / area:ui / area:desktop. Desktop command-chip renderer uses .includes('<command-name>/clear</command-name>') on message content. Quoting the tag paints /clear chip + (no output) + Context cleared and collapses scrollback. JSONL continuous. Canary recalled. Present since 1.14271.0 / 2.1.183 through 1.40609.0 / 2.1.251.
